BrochureContent.Content:
3 Cúl Bán is a truly exceptional five-bedroom detached family residence with seperate self contained granny flat (715 sq ft) occupying a substantial, mature and private site within an exclusive cul-de-sac setting in Knockanemore, Ovens.

Extending to approx. 2,850 sq/ft (with an additional 256 sq/ft of converted attic space) and complemented by a detached garage and a high-quality self-contained granny flat (715 sq/ft), this outstanding home offers a rare combination of generous family accommodation, beautifully maintained grounds and exceptional versatility. 

From the moment of arrival, the quality and scale of the property are immediately apparent. A sweeping driveway provides extensive parking, while mature, landscaped gardens, established hedging, trees and colourful planting create an attractive and private setting. The home itself has been exceptionally well maintained and thoughtfully laid out to cater for the needs of modern family living, with bright, spacious accommodation extending over two floors and further complemented by a converted attic room. 

The accommodation is centred around an impressive double-height entrance hall featuring a striking staircase and galleried landing, creating a wonderful sense of space and natural light throughout the home. The ground floor comprises a superb selection of reception and living spaces including a beautifully appointed living room, elegant family room, study, playroom and sunroom, together with a guest W.C. At the heart of the property lies a magnificent open-plan kitchen/dining area fitted with handcrafted cabinetry, a feature island and generous dining space, while an adjoining utility room provides excellent practicality for everyday family life.
Upstairs, the generous accommodation continues with five versatile bedrooms, including a superb principal suite complete with walk-in wardrobe and en suite shower room. The remaining bedrooms are all generously proportioned, benefitting from excellent natural light, quality finishes and ample storage. A luxurious family bathroom together with an additional shared en suite comfortably serve the remaining accommodation, while a converted attic room accessed via Stira staircase provides a valuable additional space suitable for a variety of uses including a home office, games room or hobby room. 

The exceptional outdoor space further enhances the appeal of this wonderful home. The mature grounds have been thoughtfully landscaped and meticulously maintained, incorporating expansive lawns, established planting, trees and a private patio area ideally suited to outdoor dining and entertaining. The home is also wired for an electric car charging unit for added practicality. Of particular note is the substantial detached garage and self-contained granny flat. Finished to an excellent standard throughout, the granny flat extends to approx. 715 sq/ft and provides quality independent accommodation and offers superb flexibility for multi-generational living, guest accommodation, home office use or independent family members. 

Located in the sought-after area of Ovens, the home is ideally positioned just a short work from the local Church, Ovens National School and Éire Óg GAA club, along with close proximity to local shops, petrol stations, and Lakewood recreational facilities including an astro-turf soccer pitch, tennis courts, pitch and putt, and a clubhouse pub. The Kilumney Inn, Bridge restaurant, Salon 28 and Haus of Beauty salon are all within 10 mins walk, while also being under 10-minute drive to Ballincollig, and under 20 minutes to Bishopstown, and Cork City from quick access to the N22.
Combining extensive family accommodation, exceptional privacy, beautifully maintained gardens and the added benefit of a detached garage and high-quality granny flat, 3 Cúl Bán represents a rare opportunity to acquire a distinguished family home in one of the most desirable residential locations on the outskirts of Cork City. 

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this outstanding property has to offer.

Entrance Hall - 
An impressive and exceptionally spacious double-height entrance hall creating a wonderful first impression upon arrival. Featuring attractive solid timber flooring, decorative wallpaper, recessed lighting and a magnificent feature staircase with carpet runner and solid timber balustrades rising to the galleried landing above. Large windows flood the space with natural light, while the generous proportions and quality finishes throughout create a warm and welcoming reception area at the heart of the home.

Living Room - 5.30m x 5.16m
A superbly proportioned living room, beautifully presented with feature wall panelling, recessed lighting and attractive timber flooring throughout. A striking solid timber fireplace with cast iron inset creates an impressive focal point, while the large bay window fills the room with natural light and provides pleasant views of the surrounding gardens. Double doors open seamlessly to the kitchen/dining area, making this an ideal space for both relaxing and entertaining. The tasteful colour palette and generous dimensions combine to create an inviting and comfortable family living space.

Family Room - 4.22m x 5.02m
A beautifully appointed family room enjoying an abundance of natural light through a feature bay window overlooking the front of the property. This elegant reception room is finished with attractive timber flooring and a stunning ornate fireplace with inset gas fire creating a warm and inviting focal point. Generously proportioned throughout, the room offers an ideal setting for both everyday family living and entertaining guests.

Kitchen/Dining Area - 7.09m x 4.53m
A superb open-plan kitchen/dining room designed with both family living and entertaining in mind. This bright and generously proportioned space features an extensive range of handcrafted fitted units, complemented by quality worktops, tiled flooring and a striking central island with breakfast bar seating. Integrated appliances are neatly incorporated within the cabinetry, while recessed lighting enhances the contemporary feel throughout. The dining area enjoys ample space for formal and informal gatherings and flows seamlessly to the adjoining sunroom, allowing natural light to flood the room and further enhancing the sense of space. A practical utility room is conveniently located just off the kitchen.

Utility Room - 2.56m x 2.61m
A practical and well-appointed utility room fitted with a range of matching wall and floor units, providing excellent storage and additional workspace. Complete with sink unit, tiled flooring and countertop space, this functional room is ideally suited to everyday family living. A door provides convenient access to the rear patio and garden, while a large window allows for plenty of natural light throughout the day.

Sunroom - 3.36m x 3.46m
A wonderful sunroom extension overlooking the beautifully maintained rear gardens and patio area. This bright and inviting space is enhanced by a vaulted timber ceiling, extensive glazing and attractive timber flooring, allowing natural light to flood the room throughout the day. Double doors provide seamless access to the outdoor entertaining area, creating an ideal indoor-outdoor connection. A charming solid fuel stove adds warmth and character, making this a superb space to relax and enjoy the peaceful garden surroundings year-round.

Study - 2.49m x 2.06m
A bright and versatile room ideally suited for use as a home office or study. Overlooking the surrounding garden, the room benefits from excellent natural light through a large picture window, while timber flooring and neutral décor create a comfortable and welcoming environment. Generously proportioned, this adaptable space offers an ideal setting for remote working, studying or a variety of family needs.

Playroom - 4.22m x 2.61m
Situated to the rear of the home, this spacious playroom can fit a variety of needs. Finished with contemporary wood-effect flooring and wall panelling, recessed lighting and direct access to the rear patio through glazed double doors, this room offers a wonderful addition to this expansive home.

W.C - 
Conveniently located off the entrance hall, this well-presented guest W.C. is fitted with a two-piece suite. Finished with tiled flooring, the room provides an attractive and practical facility for visitors and everyday family use.

Landing - 
A striking galleried landing overlooking the impressive double-height entrance hall below, creating a wonderful sense of space throughout the first floor. Finished with attractive solid timber flooring, this bright and spacious area is enhanced by large windows and a feature chandelier that floods the space with natural light. The landing provides access to the upstairs accommodation and the attic room via a Stira.

Main Bedroom - 4.70m x 5.47m
A magnificent main bedroom beautifully positioned to enjoy natural light through an attractive bay window arrangement overlooking the front of the home. This elegant and spacious room features solid timber flooring, recessed lighting and ample space for a full suite of bedroom furniture, creating a luxurious and relaxing retreat. The accommodation is further enhanced by a generous walk-in wardrobe providing excellent storage and direct access to a fully appointed en suite bathroom, offering both comfort and convenience for modern family living.

Ensuite - 
A well-appointed three-piece shower suite with Mira electric shower attachment accessed directly from the main bedroom. Fully tiled for ease of maintenance, the room benefits from a large privacy-glazed window which fills the space with natural light.

Bedroom 2 - 3.39m x 4.15m
A spacious double bedroom overlooking the rear of the property and enjoying pleasant views of the surrounding gardens. The room benefits from an extensive range of fitted wardrobes providing excellent storage together with a fitted dressing area. A large window fills the room with natural light, while the generous proportions and bright, airy feel make this a comfortable and inviting bedroom retreat. There is also the benefit of direct access to a shared ensuite.

Ensuite - 
A spacious and well-appointed ensuite shower room fitted with a three-piece suite with shower cubicle. The room is fully tiled and benefits from a large privacy-glazed window, allowing for excellent natural light and ventilation.

Bedroom 3 - 4.22m x 3.72m
Another generously proportioned double bedroom enjoying natural light from multiple windows overlooking the front gardens. The room benefits from attractive timber flooring, and direct ensuite access, while the spacious layout easily accommodates a double bed and additional furnishings.

Bedroom 4 - 3.42m x 3.18m
A bright and spacious double bedroom enjoying pleasant views over the surrounding gardens through a large window that fills the room with natural light. Finished with attractive solid timber flooring and a centre light fixture.

Bedroom 5/Walk in Wardrobe - 3.97m x 3.18m
Another versatile room, currently in use as a walk-in-wardrobe, with extensive built-in storage, making it a wonderfully practical space, that could also be an additional fifth bedroom if it were required. This room features wood flooring, overhead lighting and a window overlooking the rear garden and patio.

Bathroom - 2.41m x 3.18m
A luxurious family bathroom finished to an excellent standard and featuring a comprehensive four-piece suite comprising a corner Jacuzzi bath and separate shower enclosure. Fully tiled throughout, the room is both stylish and practical, with recessed lighting and a large privacy-glazed window providing excellent natural light. Generously proportioned and beautifully presented, this impressive bathroom offers a wonderful setting for relaxation while comfortably serving the needs of a busy family home.

Attic Room - 7.96m x 2.99m
Accessed via a Stira staircase, this superb, converted attic room provides an excellent additional living space and offers a wide variety of potential uses, including a games room, home office or hobby room. Finished with attractive timber flooring and two large Velux roof windows, the room enjoys excellent natural light while creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A TV point is provided, making it ideally suited for recreational use, while extensive eaves storage surrounds the room, delivering exceptional practical storage space.

Granny Flat - 
A significant feature of this exceptional property is the superb 715 sq/ft self-contained one bedroom, one bathroom granny flat, thoughtfully designed and finished to an outstanding standard throughout. Accessed via its own private entrance, the accommodation offers a wonderful degree of independence and flexibility while remaining conveniently connected to the main residence.Internally, the accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a spacious double bedroom, a versatile storeroom with access to the floored attic via a Stira, a beautifully appointed shower room and a stunning open-plan kitchen/living/dining area with the benefit of a connected utility room. The contemporary kitchen is fitted with an attractive range of shaker-style units, quality work surfaces and a large central island with breakfast bar seating, while French doors and large windows flood the space with natural light and enjoy attractive views over the surrounding gardens and countryside. The living area is centred around a stylish feature media wall incorporating an electric fireplace, creating a warm and inviting focal point. Throughout the accommodation, tasteful décor, modern flooring, recessed lighting and quality finishes combine to create a bright, comfortable and highly practical living environment.Together with the detached garage and extensive grounds, the granny flat represents a valuable and increasingly sought-after feature that significantly enhances the appeal and versatility of this outstanding family home.

Garden - 
Set in a quiet cul de sac and occupying a substantial and beautifully maintained site, the property is approached via a sweeping tarmacadam driveway providing extensive parking and turning space for numerous vehicles. The impressive, detached residence enjoys an attractive setting amidst mature, landscaped gardens, with well-established hedging, specimen trees, colourful shrubbery and manicured planting beds creating a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion. The generous frontage enhances the home's commanding presence while showcasing the quality and scale of the accommodation on offer.To the rear, the grounds continue to impress with expansive lawns and mature boundaries providing an idyllic setting for family life. A patio area extends from the house, offering the perfect space for outdoor dining, entertaining and relaxing while enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The gardens have been thoughtfully designed and meticulously maintained, creating a wonderful balance of open lawn, mature planting and private outdoor living space.Further enhancing the practicality and versatility of the property is a substantial detached garage and a self-contained granny flat. This valuable additional accommodation offers a wide range of potential uses, including guest accommodation, a home office, multi-generational living or independent space for older children. Together with the extensive parking, impressive gardens and detached facilities, the outdoor amenities perfectly complement this exceptional family home.
